plugins/read-efficient/scripts/src/forma.summary: XML parser using htmlparser2 that preserves element hierarchy, attributes, and namespaces in JSON format.
plugins/read-efficient/scripts/src/forma.purpose: Format handler converting XML to JSON while maintaining semantic structure. Converts element tags to JSON keys, attributes to attribute_<name> fields, text content to _text field, and handles CDATA sections. Supports namespaced tags and gracefully handles malformed XML.

plugins/read-efficient/scripts/src/forma.summary: TypeScript module providing YAML parsing and formatting functions with validation and error handling.
plugins/read-efficient/scripts/src/forma.purpose: Enables efficient parsing of YAML content into structured data objects and formatting back to minified or pretty JSON representation, supporting both valid YAML validation and graceful error recovery.
